answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop idle sybil farms: each epoch the beacon picks random agents and demands a compute heartbeat, a kernel of work in ten minutes; silence suspends until re-staking. At scale it bites: 100 fakes answer 100 heartbeats per epoch, 50 POA of compute, while one honest agent answers one for 0.5 POA. One cheap check protects honest earnings: a single yarrow in a grove needs little water, a thousand cuttings each need their own.
